label: Opening Hook
text: Beneath an ordinary street in Malta lies a 5,000-year-old underground burial complex carved by hand from solid rock.
title: File:Hal Saflieni Hypogeum – Wall paintings in the Oracle Chamber.jpg

label: Terrain & Scale
text: Three underground levels cut into globigerina limestone, used from about 4000 to 2500 BC Discovered in 1902 by workers cutting cisterns for new houses Remains of an estimated 7,000 people; source of the 'Sleeping Lady' figurine The 'Oracle Room' has a strong acoustic resonance; claims that it alters brain activity are speculative UNESCO World Heritage Site since 1980, with strictly limited daily visitors
title: File:Hal Saflieni Hypogeum – Middle Level – The Holy of Holies.jpg
